title: Fasteners and connectors in contact with preservative-treated and fire-retardant-treated
officialText:
wood. Fasteners and connectors in contact with preservative-treated and fire-retardant-treated wood shall be in
accordance with Sections 2304.9.5.1 through 2304.9.5.4. The coating weights for zinc-coated fasteners shall
be in accordance with ASTM A 153.
